title: EFC claim-gate matrix
description: Per-claim coverage of the ten review gates (gates.json). CLOSED (C10). Binds to the verdict by verdict_id and verdict_sha256 so a matrix cannot be silently re-pointed at a different verdict. A promoted claim must show every gate as satisfied or not_applicable (never open); the release gate refuses otherwise. The evidence/reason obligations (satisfied -> evidence, not_applicable -> reason, open forbidden on a promoted claim) are enforced by efc_review_gate.py, not by conditional schema branches — a phrase can never be mistaken for a binding check.

verdict_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact verdict.json this matrix binds to. efc_review_gate.py refuses on mismatch.

status.description: satisfied = gate proven (evidence required by the gate); open = gate not yet disposed (forbidden on a promoted claim); not_applicable = gate does not apply to this claim (reason required by the gate).

evidence.description: required by the gate when status is satisfied.

reviewer_role.description: the role that supplied this gate's evidence.

reason.description: required by the gate when status is not_applicable.
